3f46e983fe3c: MultiDatePick: Salesforce Calendar and Multi-Date Picker
04cb64e2f9cd: Salesforce-native Lightning Web Component suite for multi-date selection, scheduling, and resource booking.
74eaefe9e616: A Salesforce calendar component suite for picking many dates, scheduling times and booking rooms, people or equipment. Three components (Date, Date Time and Booking) render the same records in five views: month calendar, resource timeline, week grid, utilization heatmap and agenda. Recurring patterns, status colors, edit mode, capacity and conflict detection, a Setup Wizard and a Config Library. Works in Screen Flows, Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Sites. No Apex required.

3285c45dd3f1: Capacity mode lets several bookings share a time slot up to a limit you set with a number field on the resource, such as 10 seats. 138af7ef7455: Yes. Every component has a Recurring Pattern option: weekdays, weekends or any days of the week, every 1, 2, 3 or N weeks, and monthly occurrences such as the 1st Monday, the 2nd and 4th Friday or the last Saturday. A 50-click task becomes two clicks.
3e25c911b3f2: No. MultiDatePick is 100% native and runs entirely inside your org, with no external servers and no callouts. It has passed the Salesforce AppExchange Security Review.
ecae55c9782f: Any edition that supports Lightning Web Components and Screen Flows: Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance, Developer and Salesforce Platform, plus industry clouds such as Nonprofit, Education, Health, Financial Services, Public Sector and Manufacturing.
